intro: Timberling Sprouts are young, nascent plant elementals taking root near the shores of Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil. Even in their earliest growth, these sprouts show signs of corruption, prompting night elf wardens to pull them before they mature into aggressive timberlings.

p: Timberlings are plant spirits closely tied to the natural vitality of Teldrassil, but the seedlings sprouting along Lake Al'Ameth have worried the local night elves. Rather than emerging healthy and in harmony with the wild, they sprout already tainted and aggressive. Because these infant sprouts appear beyond cleansing or natural healing, caretakers at Lake Al'Ameth must gather and destroy them to prevent an uncontrolled spread of hostile timberlings across the fragile boughs of the newly planted World Tree.
